description: Implementation of the Category Data Access Object (DAO) for managing category entities in a sales management application. This class provides methods to retrieve categories by various attributes such as name, SEO URL, code, IDs, lineage, depth, parent, and store, leveraging QueryDSL and JPA for database interactions.

classes.name: CategoryDaoImpl
classes.description: Java class implementing CategoryDao to perform database operations related to Category entities, including retrieval by various attributes and listing categories under specific conditions.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of categories matching a given name within a specific store and language.

methods.name: listBySeUrl
methods.description: Lists categories matching a specific SEO URL within a store.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Gets a single category by its SEO URL within a store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a category by its code within a store.

methods.name: getByCodes
methods.description: Retrieves categories matching a list of codes within a store and language.

methods.name: getByIds
methods.description: Retrieves categories matching a list of IDs within a store and language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Gets a category by its ID and language.

methods.name: getByCode (overload)
methods.description: Retrieves a category by merchant store code and category code.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a category by its ID.

methods.name: listByLineage
methods.description: Lists categories that match a specific lineage pattern within a store or by store code.

methods.name: listByDepth
methods.description: Lists categories at a specific depth within a store, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: listByParent
methods.description: Lists child categories of a given category, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: listByStoreAndParent
methods.description: Lists categories under a specific store and parent category, with null checks.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all categories within a store.

methods.name: countProductsByCategories
methods.description: Counts the number of products associated with given categories within a store, considering availability and date.

methods.name: listByStore (with language)
methods.description: Lists categories within a store filtered by language.
